description:
Using the SQL execution tool in LibreOffice Base (Tools → SQL), delete all records associated with the 'Heavy Metal Classic' playlist (PlaylistId = 17) from the Chinook database.

You must execute two DELETE statements in the correct order to respect referential integrity:
1. First, delete all track associations: DELETE FROM "PlaylistTrack" WHERE "PlaylistId" = 17
2. Then, delete the playlist itself: DELETE FROM "Playlist" WHERE "PlaylistId" = 17

Note: Table and column names are case-sensitive and must be enclosed in double quotes (e.g., "PlaylistTrack").

After executing both DELETE statements, close the SQL dialog and save the database (File → Save) so the changes persist in /home/ga/chinook.odb.
